executive_summary.text: Cost year 2022: the home reported $301,022 in management fees (cost report line m12).
Cost year 2022: nursing pool (agency) cost reported was $3,041,661.
Cost year 2022: direct care cost was $204.71 per resident day (49.7% of expenses); Connecticut median $160.73.
Cost year 2022: nursing home operating margin was -13.7% (Connecticut median -0.4%).
